# Copilot Instructions: Social Bingo\n\n[ ] Lint: npm run lint \n[ ] Test: npm test \n[ ] Build: npm run build\n\nSingle-page React (Vite) app with Tailwind v4. Entry: src/main.tsx  src/App.tsx.\n\nKey concepts\n- Presentational components under src/components; prefer composition over global stores.\n- Game logic in src/utils/bingoLogic.ts: generateBoard, 	oggleSquare, checkBingo. Board is 5x5; CENTER_INDEX = 12 is free.\n- UI state + persistence in src/hooks/useBingoGame.ts (localStorage). Storage versioning and SSR guards are implemented; validate before migrating.\n- Questions in src/data/questions.ts (24 chosen + free center).\n- Styling uses Tailwind v4 @theme tokens defined in src/index.css (eg. --color-accent).\n\nDev commands\n- Install: npm ci\n- Dev: npm run dev (vite at http://localhost:5173)\n- Lint: npm run lint\n- Test: npm test\n- Build: npm run build\n\nConventions & patterns\n- Keep state immutable; 	oggleSquare returns new arrays. Avoid in-place mutations.\n- Dont toggle the free center; logic intentionally ignores it.\n- Add unit tests in src/utils for rules and board behaviors before changing logic.\n- Avoid adding global stores; use small hooks + prop drilling.\n\nCommon gotchas\n- Changing board size (25 -> X) requires updates in BOARD_SIZE, CENTER_INDEX, tests, and UI.\n- localStorage uses strict validation; update STORAGE_VERSION when changing persistence schema.\n- Keep tests and UI in sync when altering IDs (0-24).\n\nWhere to change things\n- Game rules: src/utils/bingoLogic.ts\n- Persistence: src/hooks/useBingoGame.ts\n- Content: src/data/questions.ts\n- UI: src/components/ (StartScreen, GameScreen, BingoBoard)\n\nIf unsure: open a PR with tests first; ping the repo owner for schema-breaking changes.
